about: Ceilings of the volume test (runner/tests/volume.rs) at the shipped defaults: N objects seen by a radar and a beacon for 120 s of input (runner/volume/scenario.py), correlate-assign-time then quality-feed. Fabric and disk figures are deterministic for a given input and get 25% headroom; memory varies with the machine and gets 50%. 'measured' is the run that set each ceiling (runner 0.6.1 plus this change, on a 16-core x86-64 host). A change that needs a higher ceiling raises it here, in the same pull request, with the reason in the commit.
